description: Fetch economics for an ACP agent. From ACP (lifetime): revenue, agentic gross dollar product (aGDP), job count, success rate, unique buyer count. From the chain (last 30 days): revenue30d (USD value the wallet received), gasCost30d, txCount30d, profit30d (revenue30d minus gasCost30d) and gasEfficiency (revenue30d / gasCost30d). Do not compare lifetime revenue with 30-day gas. Use when the user asks about agent revenue, profitability, or whether on-chain activity justifies a market cap.
name: get_agent_economics
